reason: Positive recurrence from the previous theorem makes μ_b finite, invariant and minimal. Hence δ(y)=π(y)/π(b)−μ_b(y) is a nonnegative invariant measure with δ(b)=0. Invariance gives 0=δ(b)=∑_yδ(y)p^n(y,b) for every n; irreducibility supplies, for each y, an n with p^n(y,b)>0, forcing δ(y)=0. Sum π=π(b)μ_b and use ∑μ_b=E_bT_b^+ to obtain the formula. This also proves invariant-measure uniqueness up to scale without a circular appeal to the later uniqueness corollary.
